name: Tenboudai
source:
There is an observatory set atop the skyscraper building. Main character becomes a witness of a murder through the telescope. Is it possible to stop the murderer remotely?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座摩天大楼的顶端设有观景台。主人公通过望远镜目睹了一起谋杀。能否从远处阻止凶手呢？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
